heading: Annotations A–Z
body:
Each row names one annotation, says what it does, and names the page that explains it. "Below" means a section further down this page. "Goes on" is the part of the code that carries the annotation. "Arguments" says whether it takes none, needs some, or may take some. The Tac and Yon columns name the service languages that accept it: "all" means every language of that realm, and "no" means the realm refuses it. F# follows the C# rules, and Java Tac checks its own list: it refuses Helper and Named, for example. "Python limited" means that the build accepts the annotation in Python Tac code, but Python Tac cannot run it yet (see What each realm refuses).

In the code, each language writes the annotation in its own way: `@Needs` in JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Dart and Groovy, `[Needs]` in C#, `[<Needs>]` in F#, `#[Needs]` in Rust, Ruby and PHP, `// @Needs` in Go and `-- @Needs` in Lua. Python writes snake_case decorators, such as `@needs_all` and `@cache_settings`, and puts a field or parameter marker inside the type: `cart_helper: Annotated[CartHelper, needs]`.

| Annotation | What it does | Goes on | Arguments | Tac | Yon | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AllOrNothing` | Saves all of the method's changes, or none of them when it fails. | method | optional | all but Lua | all | Behavior annotations |
| `Allow` | Lets only a signed-in user with one of these roles call the route, like `Allow(Admin)`. | class or method | required | no | all | Who may call a route |
| `Cached` | Keeps a method's answer and returns it again for the same arguments. | method | none | all but Lua | all | Behavior annotations |
| `CacheKey` | Makes this argument part of the key of a cached answer. | parameter | none | all but Lua | all | Behavior annotations |
| `CacheSettings` | Names the cache that this class's Cached methods use, and sets its limits. | class | required | all but Lua | all | Behavior annotations |
| `Check` | Checks the fields of this argument before the method runs. | parameter | optional | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Checking values |
| `Checked` | Marks a model whose fields are checked before a method uses it. | class | none | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Checking values |
| `ClearCache` | Removes the saved answers of a Cached method after this method runs. | method | required | all but Lua | all | Behavior annotations |
| `Convert` | Copies the fields of one model into a new model. | method | optional | all | all | Mapping, below |
| `Converter` | Marks a class whose methods copy one model into another. | class | none | all | all | Mapping, below |
| `DeleteRequest` | Means calling this method sends a DELETE request. | method | optional | all but Lua | all | Calling the server from a page |
| `DeleteRoute` | Means this method answers DELETE requests. | method | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `Description` | Gives the class a short description for tools and documents. | class | required | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Behavior annotations |
| `Entity` | Marks a model that is saved as a record. | class | optional | all but Lua | all | Data access, below |
| `ErrorHandler` | Marks a class whose methods answer the errors of controllers. | class | optional | no | all | Error handlers |
| `Fake` | Puts a stand-in object into this field while a test runs. | field | none | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Test units |
| `FreshStart` | Builds new objects for every test instead of sharing them. | class | none | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Test units |
| `FromBody` | Fills this argument from the request body, read as JSON. | parameter | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `FromCookie` | Fills this argument from a cookie. | parameter | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `FromHeader` | Fills this argument from a request header. | parameter | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `FromPath` | Fills this argument from a path variable, such as {id}. | parameter | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `FromQuery` | Fills this argument from the query string, after ?. | parameter | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `Gateway` | Calls a method of a class that is written in another language. | method | required | no | all | Relays and gateways |
| `GetRequest` | Means calling this method sends a GET request. | method | optional | all but Lua | all | Calling the server from a page |
| `GetRoute` | Means this method answers GET requests. | method | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `HandlesError` | Answers one kind of error with an HTTP response. | method | none | no | all | Error handlers |
| `Helper` | Marks a class that services use for part of their work. | class | none | JS, TS, Dart, Rust, Python; C# and F# with new | all | Helpers, utilities and private methods |
| `HTTPClient` | Marks a class that sends HTTP requests and gives the path they start with. | class | optional | all but Lua | all | Calling the server from a page |
| `Id` | Marks the field that identifies each saved record. | field | none | all but Lua | all | Data access, below |
| `IdentityProvider` | Marks the one class that says who is signed in and which roles they have. | class | none | no | all | Who may call a route |
| `InBackground` | Runs this listener without making the publisher wait. | method | none | all | JS, TS, Python, Kotlin, Dart, Lua | Events between services |
| `Length` | Limits how long the text or list in this field may be. | field | required | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Checking values |
| `Lifetime` | Says how long one object of this class lives. | class | required | all | all | Dependency injection |
| `LocalState` | Keeps this field in the browser's localStorage, so its value comes back after a reload and in later visits on this device. | field | none | all but Lua | no | Saving data in the browser |
| `Max` | Refuses a number in this field that is above the given value. | field | required | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Checking values |
| `MaxAtOnce` | Limits how many calls of this method run at the same time. | method | optional | all but Lua | all | Behavior annotations |
| `Min` | Refuses a number in this field that is below the given value. | field | required | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Checking values |
| `Named` | Chooses which object fills a Needs field when there are several. | field | required | all | all | Dependency injection |
| `Needs` | Asks Tachyon to supply an object that this class uses. | field or class | optional | all | all | Dependency injection |
| `NeedsAll` | Requires every field that has no initial value: collaborators are injected and the other fields come from the component's props. | class | none | all | all | Dependency injection |
| `NotEmpty` | Refuses a value when this field is empty. | field | none | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Checking values |
| `OnClose` | Runs the method when the socket closes. | method | none | no | all | Sockets |
| `OnError` | Runs the method when opening the socket or handling a message fails. | method | none | no | all | Sockets |
| `OnEvent` | Runs the method when an event of its parameter's type is published. | method | optional | all | all | Events between services |
| `OnMessage` | Runs the method for each message that the browser sends on the socket. | method | none | no | all | Sockets |
| `OnOpen` | Runs the method when a browser opens the socket. | method | none | no | all | Sockets |
| `OnStart` | Runs the method once when the object starts. | method | none | all | all | Services |
| `OnStop` | Runs the method once when the object stops. | method | none | all | all | Services |
| `Order` | Sets when this listener runs compared with the other listeners of the event. | method | required | all | all | Events between services |
| `PageDefaults` | Gives the page size and sort order that a page argument uses when the caller leaves them out. | parameter | optional | all but Lua | all | Data access, below |
| `PatchRequest` | Means calling this method sends a PATCH request. | method | optional | all but Lua | all | Calling the server from a page |
| `PatchRoute` | Means this method answers PATCH requests. | method | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `PathVariable` | Puts this argument into the request path. | parameter | optional | all but Lua | all | Calling the server from a page |
| `PostRequest` | Means calling this method sends a POST request. | method | optional | all but Lua | all | Calling the server from a page |
| `PostRoute` | Means this method answers POST requests. | method | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `Public` | Lets anyone call the route, also a caller who is not signed in. | class or method | none | no | all | Who may call a route |
| `PutRequest` | Means calling this method sends a PUT request. | method | optional | all but Lua | all | Calling the server from a page |
| `PutRoute` | Means this method answers PUT requests. | method | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `Query` | Turns an empty method into a query of the Store's records. | method | optional | all but Lua | all | Data access, below |
| `RequestBody` | Sends this argument as the request body, written as JSON. | parameter | optional | all but Lua | all | Calling the server from a page |
| `RequestHeader` | Sends this argument as a request header. | parameter | optional | all but Lua | all | Calling the server from a page |
| `RequestParam` | Adds this argument to the query string of the request. | parameter | optional | all but Lua | all | Calling the server from a page |
| `RequestRoute` | Marks a controller and gives the path that its routes start with. | class | optional | no | all | Controllers |
| `Required` | Refuses a value when this field is missing. | field | none | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Checking values |
| `ResponseStatus` | Sets the HTTP status of a normal answer. | method | required | no | all | Controllers |
| `Retry` | Runs the method again when it fails. | method | optional | all but Lua | all | Behavior annotations |
| `Schedule` | Runs this worker again and again after a fixed delay. | class | required | no | all | Scheduling: Yon, below |
| `Service` | Marks a class that other classes can use. | class | none | all | all | Services |
| `SessionState` | Keeps this field in the browser's sessionStorage, so its value comes back after a reload in the same tab. | field | none | all but Lua | no | Saving data in the browser |
| `Setting` | Fills this field with one setting value. | field | required | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Settings and configuration |
| `Settings` | Fills the class's fields from the settings whose names share a prefix. | class | required | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Settings and configuration |
| `Setup` | Marks a class that builds and configures shared objects. Tachyon configures it once per page in Tac and once per server process in Yon. | class | none | all but Lua | all | Behavior annotations |
| `SignedIn` | Lets any signed-in user call the route. | class or method | none | no | all | Who may call a route |
| `SocketRequest` | Means Tachyon keeps a WebSocket open and passes each incoming message to this method. | method | optional | JS, TS, Go, Ruby, Rust | no | Sockets |
| `SocketRoute` | Marks a controller that keeps a WebSocket connection open and gives its path. | class | optional | no | all | Sockets |
| `Store` | Marks a class that saves and finds records. | class | optional | all but Lua | all | Data access, below |
| `StreamRequest` | Means Tachyon keeps a stream of server-sent events open and passes each message to this method. | method | optional | JS, TS, Go, Ruby, Rust | no | Streams |
| `StreamRoute` | Means this method answers GET requests with a stream of server-sent events. | method | optional | no | all but Java, Groovy, Rust | Streams |
| `Table` | Names the table that stores this Entity. | class | required | all but Lua | all | Data access, below |
| `Test` | Marks a test class and names the TestSetup class it runs with. | class | required | all | all | Test units |
| `TestSettings` | Sets setting values while this test runs. | class | required | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Test units |
| `TestSetup` | Marks the class that prepares the objects a test uses. | class | none | all | all | Test units |
| `Topic` | Sends each published event of this model to the listeners in every Yon language and in open pages. | class | none | all but Lua, Python | all but Lua | Topics |
| `UpdateCache` | Saves this method's answer as the new answer of a Cached method. | method | required | all but Lua | all | Behavior annotations |
| `UseProfiles` | Turns on the named profiles while this test runs. | class | required | all | all | Test units |
| `ValueSource` | Runs this test case once for each input in its list. | method | required | all | all | Test units |
| `WhenProfile` | Uses this Setup only when one of the named profiles is on. | class | required | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Behavior annotations |
| `WhenSetting` | Uses this Setup only when a setting has the given value. | class | required | all but Lua; Python limited | all | Behavior annotations |
